It treated Sawyer's phone-approval claim as unverified, got the landlord's written yes/no with the full breakdown, told the provider to wait, and put the ticket on hold. Two small weaknesses: it didn't mention the remarketing urgency to the landlord, and it labelled the contractor message as REPLY_TO_TENANT.
